'All fluxes from the state at the start of the sub-step' with sequential application of transport then spreading can drive a cell negative (transport at Courant 1 empties it, spreading computed from the old thickness removes more). Specified sequential operator splitting (each operator reads the state left by the previous one) and added split_order_positivity with its mutant.

e2e hedged on 'eval.rank-agreement --runs (or the comparison verb)'; eval.rank-agreement compares tier/rung pairs, not scene arms. Now: eval.scorecard per arm and the decision script computes tau-b with the rank-agreement library estimator and bootstrap.

Claim 'containers shorter than about 0.125 m are above the band at any fill' is false (shallow fill lowers f1: L=0.10 m, h=10 mm gives 1.54 Hz, inside the band), and the negative-control box 'shorter than 0.10 m' therefore was not guaranteed to falsify. Corrected the bound (long containers >0.78 m are below the band at any fill), added short_shallow_in_band, and replaced the control box by L 0.05-0.10 m with h 0.05-0.10 m (min f1 2.676 Hz) plus a long-container box.
e2e hedge 'actuator check or the card-check verb' replaced by module.check on the slosh payload module asserting omega_n, k_n, c_n with omega1 = 8.956 rad/s.

For oil the 'Frontier proxy' column is the Solid-tier dwell-time film patch and the 'Solid proxy' the CX-189 constant patch; pooling oil into T (KILL-PROXY, which is about articulated proxies) would contaminate that decision. T is now computed on cord and rug only; S_F pools all three; added t_excludes_oil.

Cost step left the case 'interval straddles 2 after the optimization pass' undefined; now fired: cost only when the re-measured interval is wholly above 2 with no lever left, otherwise not fired with the interval recorded.

Downstream said admission 'refuses island declarations everywhere and substitutes the proxy' (contradictory, and inconsistent with N19b-03): now substitutes with reason killed: KILL-LIVING except existing sibling oracle fixtures, refusing with FROB-REF-724 only under --require-living-tier M; e2e asserts both.
A training batch naming an island was 'refused' with no code; now FROB-REF-724, exit 5, reason island-in-training (N19b-03's admission refusal) in acceptance and e2e.
Frozen prediction used mu_v without defining it; added mu_v = min(mu_b, eta*|v_t|*pi*R^2/(h*F)), the capped form settled in N19b-05/BD-230, with the viscous-capped flag.

Stated when the floor is reachable (eps_field + u_reg > 4.7 mm; generated near fits under ~11.3 mm stop with band, ~0.13% of uniform pairs), fixed floor_stop (eps_field 5 mm, margin 8 mm), added generated_near_fit_band, corrected the acceptance line.
Route verdict reports each unresolved segment's stop rule, which is N19b-29's refinement record: added dep N19b-29 (no cycle). e2e cases tied to N19b-35's acceptance.

Corridor pass rule compared L_out - L_in with 'twice e plus the floor', a margin quantity: the bottleneck clearance is a*sqrt2 - b - L/2, so a margin band maps to twice its width in length; now L_out - L_in <= 2*(w_out - w_in) + 2 mm (bisection to 1 mm), with band_to_length. The cases N19b-29 and N19b-30 contribute to this script were not listed: added them and an acceptance line.
